interpretation: The fixture-coherent B input window passes the preregistered diagnostic throughput gate in both cases and both treatment arms. This is measured forced-benchmark headroom, not a deployable drafter result.

Only B private target inputs are replaced all-or-nothing; original proposals/confidence/width/readiness/gates remain unchanged. More coherent carried B verification changes emissions and path-dependent total MTP work, reported explicitly.

Compared with the separate partial B-root experiment, fixing only a root while retaining stale tails did not gain throughput; this full-window diagnostic supports investigating coherent B proposals, without assigning its gains to a feasible real predictor.
GPU0/GPU1 stage rows count launched input rows. They do not measure exclusive GPU cost or establish a causal critical path.

Full B-window oracle uses fixture future inputs B.p-(n-1)-1+i only, preserves current A inputs and original probability/width/readiness. No shared oc/op mutation. Global oracle OFF, chain bypass0.
